prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training carb-loading with high calorie intake, meals timed around 6am run and evening strength training

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3-4 meals with specific timing aligned to training windows (pre-run, post-run, pre-strength session)
Daily calorie intake supports high-endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000-3500 calories)
Carbohydrate content is elevated for carb-loading strategy with emphasis on complex carbs
All meals respect vegetarian diet and exclude nuts
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single Athlete.
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring carb-loading and high calorie intake, with specific timing preferences for meals around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and muscle gain for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Minimum 1.8g protein per kg bodyweight (153g total) with relatively even distribution across meals
Includes only vegetarian protein sources (legumes, dairy, eggs, tofu, nuts, seeds)
Provides estimated macronutrient ratios approximately 40% protein, 40% carbohydrates, 20% fats
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single Athlete.

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain performance and energy levels for early morning soccer training (6:00 AM) and afternoon match preparation

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one day with quick-prep meals requiring ≤15 minutes preparation time
Includes pre-training nutrition (before 6:00 AM), post-training recovery meal, and pre-match fueling with specific hydration guidelines
All meals comply with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
Provides adequate calories and macronutrients for a 78 kg athlete with high activity demands
